answer.rationale: Primary expires in 14 days with no auto-renew and the line has no buffer, so the single decision must replace primary supply (renew or switch). Adding a second source, deferring, or negotiating after an explicit price refusal leaves a supply gap and would raise delivery risk. c1 indicates renewal preserves integration and deliveries; c2’s cost win required onboarding that is too risky to treat as non-increasing under 94% utilization. Need archive checks on those two records before locking. Spend-cut mandate is unmet and is flagged as downstream value pressure; TCO still favors avoiding a stock-out.
